company: Ganesh Ariyur, Transformation CIO / CDIO candidate. Lens on executives at the largest US public companies. Company membership is matched in code against the preset's watchlist (paste the Fortune 1000 names in Classifier Studio); before enrichment Jev only judges the role and whether the company reads as a well-known large public corporation.
targetRoles: Division President / General Manager / Business unit leader
geography: United States first; other countries rank lower, not excluded
companyProfile: Fortune 1000 companies: the largest US corporations by revenue, public and private; healthcare, life sciences, MedTech, manufacturing and industrials preferred but any sector counts
disqualifiers: Students and interns, early-career job seekers asking for mentoring, vendors and agencies selling services to CIOs, lead-generation and marketing agencies, founders of pre-revenue startups
revenueThreshold: $2B revenue (roughly the Fortune 1000 cut-off; or 5,000+ employees when revenue is unknown)
decisionAuthority: authority to hire or sponsor a C-level or divisional technology executive at a large public company, or a board seat that approves such a hire
